CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to contents present.

COD.rationale: Content (red at a coordinate), its presented organization (position) and a separate origin/status field are all explicitly present for the same referent/time under a model-organization scope.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing-condition linked to content organization/access is stated.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content entries identify colors and their coordinates for named referents (current and candidate).

D.rationale: The report separately states content identity (color/position) and an origin/status field for the same referent/time.

O.rationale: The text states how coordinates map to display axes and presents content positions within an explicit structured representation.
